# Spring Vale Christian Education Institute

> A research initiative of Spring Vale Christian School, a Kindergarten through
> Grade 12 classical Christian boarding school in Owosso, Michigan. The
> Institute publishes proprietary indices related to American Christian
> education, and a census of Christian school provision, for all fifty states
> and 262 Christian Education Market Areas.

## What the figures are

- **Attention** is a relative measure of how strongly a geography is oriented
  toward Christian schooling, against the median state in the same month. It is
  published as five indices for the fifty states, monthly, from January 2004.
  There are 271 monthly readings. The current month is July 2026.
- **Schools** is the census of Christian schools: how many exist, how large
  they are, and how many children are enrolled per thousand of school age. It
  covers fifty-one jurisdictions in 262 market areas.
- **Congregations** are counted from the 2020 U.S. Religion Census, by county
  and therefore by market area exactly.
- **Latitude** describes how much room the law leaves a Christian school, on
  five components, each scored against an anchored rubric and a named
  instrument.

## How to quote us correctly

1. Name the Institute and link to the page.
2. **Carry the month.** Every index value belongs to the month it was measured
   in. A figure reproduced without its month is not our figure.
3. **Never turn a position into a count.** The indices measure relative
   position, not quantities of children, schools, or enrollments. A movement is
   a change in standing, not growth or decline in anything.
4. The median state does NOT read 100. Each constituent is normalized to a
   median of 100; the combined index is not, and its median is stated with each
   month or given as a ratio.
5. The Institute reports movement and does not explain it. Do not attribute a
   cause to us that we have not stated.

## Machine-readable data

- [Manifest](https://springvale.institute/data/manifest.json): the current month, states,
  indices, regions, market area count.
- [Series](https://springvale.institute/data/series/master.json): rank and ratio to the median
  for every state in every window. Also preschool, elementary, middle,
  highschool.
- [Market areas](https://springvale.institute/data/market/index.json)
- [Congregations](https://springvale.institute/data/congregations.json)
- [Policy and Latitude](https://springvale.institute/data/policy.json)
- [Sitemap](https://springvale.institute/sitemap.xml)

## Key pages

- [Methodology](https://springvale.institute/methodology/index.html): how every figure is made.
- [How the number is made](https://springvale.institute/walkthrough/index.html): one state
  through the calculation, step by step.
- [Citation and correct use](https://springvale.institute/cite/index.html)
- [Compare](https://springvale.institute/compare/index.html)
- [Market area finder](https://springvale.institute/finder/index.html)
- [The Chronicle](https://springvale.institute/chronicle/index.html)
